title: Section-normalized constant-module small-site transport
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with $R=\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $T$, use the original small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and its exact small-model module equivalence $C_T=\mathrm{sfCbcModelModules}(T,R)$ from [lem-sf-constant-semilinear-generator-comparison]. For $f:V\to T$ there is a unique natural isomorphism $f_*C_T\cong C_Vf_*^{\rm model}$ whose underlying-section map, followed by the canonical constantDirectUnderlying comparison, is the identity on every section. Define ordinaryDirectModel to be this uniquely section-normalized isomorphism. Define towerModel to apply $C_T$ termwise to strict $\mathbf N^{\rm op}$-towers and derivedTowerModel to be its exact derived functor. These retain the original site object universe and morphism universe.
